title: Wizardry 7: Crusaders of the Dark Savant

aztec_begin.note: DS.EXE's $begin saves CS:PSP in a code-segment word instead of calling _exitinit_, and ends by jumping to a DOS-exit routine with AL set instead of pushing the code and calling _exit_; the debugger entry ($dbgentry) is not linked in.

edits.find:
xor	ax,ax
	push	ax		;Croot or caller should call _exit
	call	_exit_		;but just in case...

retip	dw	0
retcs	dw	0

	public $dbgentry
$dbgentry proc far
	pop	cs:retip
	pop	cs:retcs	; save return address into debugger
	pop	ds		;set DS
	call	caller
	jmp	dword ptr cs:retip ; return to debugger
$dbgentry endp

caller	proc
	push	di		;CS value of local function
	push	si		;IP value call local function
	db	0cbH		;far return instruction
caller	endp

0x0410.name: bios_data_0410
0x0410.note: BIOS Data Area equipment word low byte at absolute 0x0410 (0040:0010); accessed as es:0x0410 with es=0. Bits 4-5 hold the initial video mode, saved/cleared/restored by the video-init code around a mode set.

not_pointers.note: entry 1 of the 5-way jump table at 0x113a (jumptable_113a), NOT a DS string pointer. The dispatch is `cmp ax,5; jae; xchg bx,ax; shl bx,1; jmp word [cs:bx + 0x193c]` (vinstall/leaf_loc_10a4.asm, 0x1144-0x114c), so the word is a CS code offset; each target is a case body ending at the join point. The DS reading (0x0eca -> 'MON36.PIC') is a numeric coincidence

entry 4 of the 17-way jump table at 0x1b3c (jumptable_1b3c), NOT a DS string pointer. The DS reading (0x1806 -> '********') is a coincidence

entry 11 of the same 17-way jump table at 0x1b3c (jumptable_1b3c), NOT a DS string pointer. Target CS:0x18b2 = file 0x1ab2 is a case body ending at the join 0x1b6b. The DS reading (-> 'All Logos, Printed Materials...') is a coincidence
